_note: ace-bing-1 is a BigAirports.com statistics card, not a photo.

ace-bing-2.webp.zh: 黄昏时分的塞萨尔·曼里克-兰萨罗特机场：招牌下是种满仙人掌的下沉花园，远处能望见兰萨罗特岛的山影。
ace-bing-2.webp.en: César Manrique-Lanzarote Airport at dusk — the airport's sign above a sunken cactus garden, with the island's hills behind.

ace-doubao-01.webp.zh: 晴朗白天里的航站楼：黄色大字标出机场与一号航站楼，右侧立着塔台，前景是成片仙人掌。
ace-doubao-01.webp.en: Under a clear sky the yellow lettering names the airport and Terminal 1, the control tower to the right and cacti in front.

ace-doubao-02.webp.zh: 从花园小径仰望航站楼：黄色招牌横贯屋顶，桥下停着一排租车，柱廊投下短影。
ace-doubao-02.webp.en: Looking up from the garden path, the yellow sign runs along the roofline, rental cars parked beneath the colonnade.

ace-doubao-03.webp.zh: 空荡的机坪上望向白色航站楼，楼身上写着机场全名，两侧分别标着出发与到达。
ace-doubao-03.webp.en: Across an empty concrete apron the white terminal carries the airport's full name, with departures and arrivals marked at either side.

ace-doubao-04.webp.zh: 隔着跑道远望航站楼，两侧各停着一架客机，灯杆高耸，前景是干燥的火山碎石地。
ace-doubao-04.webp.en: From beyond the runway the terminal sits low between two parked airliners, floodlight masts above and dry volcanic ground in front.

ace-doubao-05.webp.zh: 机场外的环岛上立着一座抽象的金属雕塑，深色石块基座，背后是光秃的火山锥。
ace-doubao-05.webp.en: An abstract metal sculpture stands on a dark stone plinth in a landscaped roundabout, a bare volcanic cone rising behind.

ace-doubao-06.webp.zh: 一架客机刚离地爬升，机腹掠过海滩与长栈桥，岸边是一排白色房屋和厚重积云。
ace-doubao-06.webp.en: An airliner climbs away over the water, its belly above a beach and long pier, white houses along the shore and heavy clouds behind.
